We’re here to help

Make technology a good thing.

FIDDLE,GREEN is a small technology business based in Portland, Maine, that helps people, organizations, and communities put technology to work for them. We sit down with you, sort out what's actually going on, and leave you more confident than we found you. No jargon, no upselling, we're just here to help.

Why FIDDLE,GREEN?

We do the work properly, explain it in language you can use, and leave everything in your name. We do not upsell — we would rather you buy what you actually need and call us again than buy more and regret it.

Whatever the size of the job, you get the same people and the same straight answers. The first conversation is free and commits you to nothing.
